title: Olive and the Race Home
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week.

pages.brief: Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow standing side by side at a marked starting line on green grass.
Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow racing across the garden towards a tall tree with a nest.
Pip the sparrow, mid-race, spotting Nell the bee caught in a silvery spider web on a low green bush.
Pip the sparrow turning towards a low green bush, wings out, heading to help Nell the bee.
Olive the owl flying on alone, fast and clear of the trees, well ahead in the race.
Olive the owl landing proudly at a nest high in a tall tree, first to arrive.
Olive the owl at the nest, looking back down the garden, the path below empty so far.
Olive the owl sitting at the nest, looking thoughtful, glancing back towards the low green bush.
Olive the owl flying back to a low green bush and helping Pip the sparrow gently pull apart a sticky silvery web around Nell the bee.
Olive the owl, Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee together by the green bush, Nell free of the web, all three smiling.
